# Support

Thank you for using this project. This document explains where to get help and what kinds of support are available.

## Asking Questions
This project does not use GitHub Discussions. For a question about using enforce-rules, start with the [README](/README.md), which has an example for every keyword. If it does not answer your question, [open a question](https://github.com/Loepker-James/enforce-rules/issues/new?template=question.yml).

## Reporting Bugs
If you think you have found a bug, [open a bug report](https://github.com/Loepker-James/enforce-rules/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). The form asks for your version of enforce-rules, your Python version, a minimal example, and what you expected to happen.

## Other Kinds of Reports
- **Suggestions for a new keyword or feature:** [open a feature request](https://github.com/Loepker-James/enforce-rules/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Something that is hard to read or use:** [open an accessibility report](https://github.com/Loepker-James/enforce-rules/issues/new?template=accessibility.yml).
- **A security problem:** please do not open a public issue. [Report it privately](https://github.com/Loepker-James/enforce-rules/security/advisories/new).
- **A Code of Conduct problem:** see [§5 of the Code of Conduct](/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#5-reporting).

## What Support Is Provided
This project provides support for:
- issues directly related to the code in this repository
- reproducible bugs
- documentation corrections
- feature requests related to the project's goals

## What Support Is Not Provided
The maintainer cannot help with:
- debugging code that does not involve enforce-rules
- problems with your own environment that enforce-rules does not cause (a packaging or install problem in this project is a bug, and you are welcome to report it)
- rewriting or customizing the project for individual needs
- general programming help

## Supported Versions
Support is provided for the latest release, on Python 3.10 and later.
Support is provided for the latest release and the current development branch.
